projects.name: Project              	:  MIL Project
details: Environment	:  Cloud Environment
Tools            	:  Pyspark, Python, SQL, Jira, Azure Databricks
Description:

This project aims to be built in a modular tool / platform for end-to-end processing of MIL (Merchant Installment Loan) Receiving the data from different source systems and transform into the dhub environment. The product enables a cardholder to make a purchase with a participating merchant, and repay the amount by fixed monthly installments over a predetermined period (e.g., 6–60 months) instead of paying the full amount immediately. The merchant-installment loan is structured such that the bank (Citi) pays the merchant upfront for the transaction, and the cardholder repays Citi in instalments.
Responsibilities:
Understanding source systems and customer requirements
Involved in functional study of the application
Verifying the Mapping document

entry.text: Project              	:  MIL Project
Role              	:  Lead Data Engineer
Environment	:  Cloud Environment
Tools            	:  Pyspark, Python, SQL, Jira, Azure Databricks
Duration   		:  May 2025 to Dec 2025
Description:

This project aims to be built in a modular tool / platform for end-to-end processing of MIL (Merchant Installment Loan) Receiving the data from different source systems and transform into the dhub environment. The product enables a cardholder to make a purchase with a participating merchant, and repay the amount by fixed monthly installments over a predetermined period (e.g., 6–60 months) instead of paying the full amount immediately. The merchant-installment loan is structured such that the bank (Citi) pays the merchant upfront for the transaction, and the cardholder repays Citi in instalments.
Responsibilities:
Understanding source systems and customer requirements
Involved in functional study of the application
Verifying the Mapping document
Verifying the data which is loaded into target database
Developed unit test cases
Develop efficient Autosys job pipelines for synchronizing client data across different layers with reduced processing time.
Developed PySpark code for automating the business operation on Azure Databricks Using Autosys jobs.
Developed Spark SQL queries for Data Analytics.
Participation in Requirements calls to understand the requirements
Validated the Historical data after full load
Creation of incremental data to test the inserts/updates/delete at source
Involved in daily defect and status calls

This new US GAAP revenue standard will replace nearly all existing US GAAP guidance on revenue recognition for virtually all industries.

Description - Project deals in the new revenue standard was the result of a joint multi-year project by the US FASB and the IASB (International Accounting Standards Board) to create converged revenue standards for both US GAAP and IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) with the goal of achieving greater consistency and comparability for revenue reporting globally. This new US GAAP revenue standard will replace nearly all existing US GAAP guidance on revenue recognition for virtually all industries.
